title: Snow Tree
body:
Description

Snow Trees are trees that have bark of a white color, with transparent dark blue leaves that almost appear glass like. Snow Trees are located in the Icelands, previously located in Snowlands prior to Christmas Update 2024

Trivia

  • The Original Snow Tree design was changed to a newer version made by Jak (who was a developer in trial at the time).
  • The Snow Tree's wood when sanded is the first wood in the game to have slippery physics applied to them, similarly to Quartz and its Pink Variant, and Frost Wood from Lumber Tycoon 2. Sanded Snow wood will slide around and the distance will depend on the amount of force applied to them.
  • The Snow Tree's design is similar to Blue Pine.
  • The Snow Tree requires Tier 2 Equipment for processing.
  • Despite being far easier to obtain, the Snow Tree is worth more than the Suiratcal.
